# NowNovel

> > A comprehensive writing platform offering guides, techniques, and resources for novelists to craft, publish, and overcome creative challenges.

NowNovel provides educational content on novel writing craft, self-publishing strategies, and creative storytelling techniques. The site features guides on narrative structure, literary devices, character development, and publishing platforms like Amazon KDP and audiobook distribution.

## Key Topics

- Novel Writing
- Self-Publishing
- Story Structure
- Character Development
- Writing Craft
- Narrative Techniques
- Amazon KDP
- Fiction Writing
- Literary Devices
- Writing Prompts
- NaNoWriMo
- Audiobook Publishing
- Editing
- Writer's Block
- Creative Writing

## Narrative Structure & Story Craft

- [Three-Act vs. Five-Act Structure](https://nownovel.com/three-act-vs-five-act-structure): Comparison of narrative frameworks with Hunger Games examples and story structure.
- [What Is Metafiction? A Guide to Self-Aware Writing](https://nownovel.com/metafiction): Guide to metafiction with examples from Calvino, Vonnegut, and self-aware narrative techniques.
- [Foreshadowing Examples in Literature](https://nownovel.com/foreshadowing-examples): Foreshadowing literary device examples from Tartt, Eugenides, and Brontë.
- [8 Exposition Examples to Help Craft Your Story](https://nownovel.com/exposition-examples-story-background): Exposition techniques with examples from King, García Márquez, and Morrison.
- [Plotter Vs. Pantser](https://nownovel.com/plotter-vs-pantser): Comparison of plotting vs. pantsing methods with King and R.L. Stine approaches.

## Self-Publishing & Distribution

- [Is KDP Worth It? A Realistic Guide for Self-Publishing Authors](https://nownovel.com/is-kdp-worth-it): Realistic guide to Amazon KDP with costs, royalties, and earning potential analysis.
- [How to Publish an Audiobook](https://nownovel.com/how-to-publish-an-audiobook): Step-by-step guide to audiobook publishing via ACX, Amazon, KDP, and Audible.

## Writing Techniques & Genres

- [Comedic Writing: How to Write a Funny Story](https://nownovel.com/comedic-writing): Beginner's guide to comedic writing with Pratchett examples and professional tips.
- [What Is Narrative Nonfiction? Characteristics & Examples](https://nownovel.com/narrative-nonfiction): Guide to narrative nonfiction with examples from Boo and creative storytelling techniques.
- [100 Poem Ideas to Fix Your Writer's Block](https://nownovel.com/poem-ideas): 100 poem ideas and poetry prompts to overcome writer's block with creative exercises.

## Writing Education & Resources

- [What Are the Best Online Writing Courses in 2026?](https://nownovel.com/best-online-writing-courses): Comparison of online writing courses including MasterClass, Gotham Writers, and Faber Academy.
- [What Is NaNoWriMo? Reasons to Still Do It](https://nownovel.com/what-is-nanowrimo): Guide to NaNoWriMo writing challenge and 50k-word novel writing motivation.
